title: Pam A NDE 934
content:
After falling down, I entered into another universe, I’d rather say into space, in a strong light. I felt wonderfully well, I was no more hungry and I didn’t suffer any more. It seemed to me that I was able to understand everything and to give, finally, a sense to my life. I was aware of being dead and earth seemed so far away. I had no more any link with earth, I knew flying. I met other beings, who, as me, had no body anymore. But anyway, I could enter them and then know what they felt and who they were, even if I didn’t know them. Then I met Christ himself. I recognized him straightaway. I understood he wanted me to go back to earth but I didn’t want to do so. But he told me it was not the time for me and that we’ll see each other again pretty soon. I’m very attached to my family but at this moment this had absolutely no importance at all. I had no opportunity at all to make contact with earth or people living on earth. And I was not anymore interested in doing so. I had been attracted back to earth and when I woke up, I was very angry against my family who helped me to breath again.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: No Accident arrêt respiratoire et des fonctions vitales
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: No The shock had been too hard, I think I went directly behind the tunnel.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes I didn’t know the beings I met in space and except for Christ, none of them told me anything; it was not necessary, I knew everything about them. Christ told me that it was not time for me, that I had to go back to earth and that we would see us again pretty soon. They were beings of light, without body nor face and nevertheless I could see their bodies and their faces.
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes I was in the light.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: That was wonderful. What a peace!!!
elements.Did you suddenly seem to understand ever: Everything about the universe Life after death, the peace of soul, the genuine meaning of our life.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: No I wanted to stay there. I didn’t want to go back to earth but I had no choice.
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes I have not any more any fear about death and I know that something wonderful exists after. The only thing I want is to go back there as quick as possible.
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes During the experience, I had some particular gifts which are very difficult to describe to others. It’s also very difficult to describe the feelings I had.
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes I guessed some things that became real later.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: All was marvelous, the worst, to come back on earth.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes At the beginning yes, but people didn’t believe me so I preferred keeping silent. People look at you, smiling, as if you were crazy, so I prefer keeping all this only for me.
